scope: CPU teaching experiments and analytic calculations; never foundation-model reproductions

00.assumptions: B=1, L=32, head_dim=128, BF16; excludes weights, activations, allocator and fragmentation.

01.assumptions: Zero logits and bias; different normalizations, so magnitudes cannot rank model quality.

02.assumptions: Fixed scalar grids and deterministic two-tone signal. Not trained RVQ, EnCodec or perceptual audio quality.

03.assumptions: Uniform grid with random phase, 0.2 s event, perfect detection if sampled. Not VLM accuracy.

04.assumptions: One FIFO server; 20 ms arrivals, no batching or network. Illustrates queue instability, not Omni latency.

05.assumptions: Fixed additive error in epsilon prediction; x0 reconstruction formula, not measured image generation.

06.assumptions: Integrator, proportional gain 2, dt=50 ms, disturbance -0.4 just before the update starting at 1.5 s; plotted states are at update ends. Not robot-policy success.

07.assumptions: Independent failures, perfect verifier, safe idempotent retries; correlated failures violate the model.

08.assumptions: Dense matmul ~2BP FLOPs and ~2P weight bytes; ignores KV/activation traffic. No GPU timing claim.

09.assumptions: Single preferred pair, sequence-summed log probabilities; no claim about visual grounding.

10.kind: executed paired bootstrap on constructed outcomes
10.assumptions: Constructed 200 independent items: both correct 80, A-only 10, B-only 20, both wrong 90. Seed 336; 4000 item-level bootstrap draws. Not a model benchmark.

11.ylabel: Test records with family in train
11.assumptions: 1000 families, independent 80/20 record split vs family-disjoint partition; duplicate membership, not downstream accuracy.

12.assumptions: Constructed dynamics y=.2*a+.8*c+noise; observational a=c+.3*noise, randomized a independent of c. Not a trained world model.
